rarityUpgrade.description: Cascading rarity upgrade system - items can upgrade to next tier with exponentially decreasing probability

itemAffixByRarity.description: Per-rarity affix bounds. PrefixSlots/StatSuffixes/ActionBonuses/ExtraComboSlots = minimums; *Max and *ExtraChance = optional random extras up to max (extra combo slots add to Item.ExtraActionSlots in LootBonusApplier). Omit a rarity to use RarityTable + built-in prefix rules for that tier.

modificationRarity.description: Modification rarity distribution percentages. Total should equal 100.0
